verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a Tools tab of ready-to-use tools that can be enabled per voice agent, and lists tools among the providers connected via Settings → Integrations, so tool use is a documented agent capability. Nothing shows developer-defined custom functions or arbitrary external API calls being invoked mid-conversation, and nothing addresses avoiding dead air during tool execution. The workflow API-call steps are outreach sequencing, not in-call function calling. missing for 10: custom function/API tool definitions, evidence of mid-call invocation with the result spoken back, latency/filler handling to avoid dead air, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Bolna provides ready-to-use tools for common voice agent workflows. Click **+ Add** next to any tool to enable it for your agent.
Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard
